name: Francisco Cerúndolo
intro: Francisco Cerúndolo is from Buenos Aires, Argentina. Everyone calls him Fran. He is famous for a huge, whip-crack forehand.
story: Fran grew up at his family's tennis academy. His mom and dad both played tennis. His little brother Juan Manuel is a pro too. His sister won a gold medal in field hockey! This summer Fran won his biggest title ever, on grass at Queen's Club in London.

funFacts.text: His secret talent is math. He loves numbers and checking stats.
His favorite foods are burgers and asado, Argentine barbecue.
He loves to sing. He packs a speaker so he can play music in every hotel room.
His sister María Constanza won field hockey gold at the Youth Olympics.
He and his brother Juan Manuel were both in the world top 100 at the same time.
His favorite movie is Gladiator. He cheers for the River Plate soccer club.
He once lost his passport on a trip and had to sleep at the airport.

watchFor: Watch him run around his backhand to smack a giant forehand. It is his favorite shot.
